title: Systematic bash node type test coverage
description:
Systematically test all bash node types and reduce test code duplication.

## Code Duplication Issue
All 9 test functions are nearly identical - only differ by test list name.
Refactor to single parametrized test or generate test functions dynamically.

## Node Type Coverage

### visit_* methods (statements/commands)
TESTED:
- command (echo, cat, true, false, exit)
- list (;, &&, ||)
- redirected_statement (heredocs)
- variable_assignment (inline with commands)

NOT TESTED:
- if_statement
- while_statement  
- for_statement
- c_style_for_statement
- case_statement
- function_definition
- pipeline (|)
- subshell ((...))
- negated_command (!)
- test_command ([[ ]])
- declaration_command (export, declare)
- unset_command

### evaluate_* methods (expressions)
TESTED:
- simple_expansion ($VAR)
- expansion (${VAR}, ${VAR:-default})
- ansi_c_string ($'...')
- word (with brace expansion)
- raw_string ('...')
- string ("...")
- heredoc_body, heredoc_content

NOT TESTED:
- arithmetic_expansion ($((...)))
- array
- binary_expression
- ternary_expression
- unary_expression
- postfix_expression
- command_substitution ($(...))
- concatenation
- subscript
- regex
- process_substitution (<(...))
